description: Find NEAR ecosystem projects in NEAR Catalog (340) by name, by what they do, or by category: category, phase, website, GitHub, tokens with their NEAR contract, TVL on NEAR from DefiLlama, security incidents, and whether it is a NEAR partner. An empty query lists the projects with the most TVL, or every project of a category ("Wallet", "DEX", "Validator"). Use for "what is Rhea Finance", "which wallets can I use on NEAR", "who does intents swaps", "has Meta Pool been hacked".

category.description: NEAR Catalog category, any case, singular or plural ("wallets", "DeFi", "DEX", "Validator"). An unknown one returns the list of categories.

limit.description: Most projects to return (default 5; up to 50 for a whole category).

query.description: Project name or words for what it does ("lending", "intents swap"); empty to list.

name: find_project
